QA Bug Report - 2026-08-27

Verdict: Bug confirmed

Item Result
Feature Profile - Edit username
Severity Critical
Test scope Real-device execution reported by QA; source review and static compilation
Persistent action Username was changed on a tester account; no further account mutations performed

Actual vs expected

Expected Actual
Saving an available username changes only the signed-in account's username and retains its identity/session. After saving a username edit, the app opens or displays another account.

Reproduction steps

  1. Sign in with tester account A and record current username, avatar, and profile details.
  2. Open Profile > Edit Profile > Username.
  3. Enter an available username and wait for availability indicator.
  4. Tap Save, then save main Edit Profile form.
  5. Return to Profile.
  6. Compare displayed identity with account recorded in step 1.

Observed: profile/session resolves to another account.
Expected: same authenticated account remains active; only username changes.

Video evidence

WhatsApp.Video.2026-08-27.at.16.45.04.mp4

Test summary

ID Method Scenario Result
EP-01 Black box Save available username Fail - identity changes to another account
EP-02 Gray box UI > Zustand > API > cache/session Fail - identity data inconsistent after save
EP-03 White box Update, cache flush, session-sync path Fail - self-detail merge retains stale username
EP-04 Negative Invalid/taken username Pass - guarded before save

Confusion matrix

Classification Count Evidence
True positive 1 Valid username-save flow exposes identity defect
False positive 0 observed Reproduced by QA
True negative 1 Invalid/taken username blocked
False negative 1 Valid input accepted although post-save identity fails

Code review

Source area Finding
src/pages/edit-profile/store/editProfileStore.ts Saves profile, flushes caches, then synchronizes self detail.
src/api/settings.ts syncOwnProfileDetail() merges detail fields without detail.username; stale session identity can drive Profile reload.
TypeScript npx tsc --noEmit passed; static check does not cover this runtime regression.

Developer validation after fix

  1. Repeat EP-01 using tester account A.
  2. Confirm Profile, stored session, Redux identity show the new username for account A.
  3. Restart app; session must still resolve to account A.
  4. Use tester account B to confirm account A profile externally.
  5. Restore temporary username if changed.
